_doc: 012/P1-5 golden eval corpus. Synthetic, deterministic, text-only (runs on MvpSystem). No real PII/tenant/fund data. Each question carries a unique identifier token present only in its target document so deterministic retrieval is stable. Used by tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py against the committed baseline tests/fixtures/eval/golden_baseline.json. ★G2 adds an unanswerable slice (answerability=unanswerable): category unanswerable_out_of_scope / unanswerable_safety items REFUSE today and are hard-gated; category unanswerable_in_domain items (a question about ABSENT in-domain content) are answered today by extracting a grounded-but-irrelevant sentence — a documented product gap held by the unanswerable_answer_rate / risk_weighted_score RATCHET in the baseline (regression blocks; improvement tightens).
